title: Art. 9.1.8 — Annex 14 - Aerodromes, Volume I - Aerodrome Design and Operations, Chapter 9 - Aerodrome Operational Services, Equipment and Installations, 9.1 Aerodrome emergency planning, 9.1.8
content: Recommendation. The emergency operations centre should be a part of the aerodrome facilities and should be responsible for the overall coordination and general direction of the response to an emergency.
